chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, in the questions of Ismāʿīl ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Akhīr عليه السلام:

Concerning an owned slave who continues to disobey his master: is it permissible to beat him or not? He عليه السلام said: “It is not permissible for you to beat him. If he is agreeable to you, then keep him; otherwise, let him go.”

key_terms.فَخَلِّ عَنْهُ: then leave him or let him go
key_terms.وَافَقَكَ: was agreeable to you or suited you
key_terms.يَعْصِي: disobeys or acts against the command of

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Shia hadith to beat a disobedient slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that striking a slave for ongoing disobedience is not permissible. The Imam عليه السلام directs the owner either to keep the slave if the situation is workable or to release him, reflecting a limitation on coercion and an emphasis on just treatment.
